question: In a certain code language, ‘SCREEN’ is coded as ‘LCCPAQ’. What is the code for ‘SKILLS’ in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

‘SCREEN’ is coded as ‘LCCPAQ’,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a74c32c8a96dcf40c36cf448f805ad998c83bff4233a0bfd3aac6b7a8e1d76cd.png] 

Similarly, for 'SKILLS'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3da29395b6edb2b99be8afd730cb828d08b65cbacd413a905faf1151c9ae24f0.png] 

So, 'SKILLS' is coded as 'QJJGIQ'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
